{"id":2031507621,"question_id":4216,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781335555,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2031507621/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Weighted Word Mapping","memory":"45 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string mapWordWeights(vector<string>& words, vector<int>& weights) {\n        unordered_map<int , int>mp;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<26 ; i++) mp[i + 'a'] = weights[i];\n\n        string ans = \"\";\n\n        for(auto it : words)\n        {\n            int sum = 0;\n            for(auto x : it) sum += mp[x];\n            sum %= 26;\n\n            ans.push_back('z' - sum);\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"weighted-word-mapping","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2100}
